name: Gospel
overview: The Gospel is portrayed as the joyful and life-giving word of the Lord that brings light and guidance to God's people. As seen in Psalms, it is like a river that refreshes the city of God and a source of help and stability, while Isaiah highlights the Gospel as the light shining in darkness, calling people to walk in God's paths. This message invites all to come to the Lord's house to learn His ways, emphasizing the transformative power of the Gospel in leading believers into the light of God's presence.
